title: Retail Installment Contracts Servicing Standard: Restriction Review Charge on Returned Payments
content:
**Standard.** A returned-payment fee on a contract under Retail Installment Contracts carries a restriction review charge read against the tier's returned-payment restriction count. The fee-bearing returns on the contract in the rolling 12 months, the return being charged included, are counted:

- when they reach the tier's restriction count, **10.00** is added;
- when they are exactly one fewer than that count, **5.00** is added;
- otherwise nothing is added.

The tier's restriction counts are:

| Tier | Restriction count | Returns giving 10.00 | Returns giving 5.00 | Returns giving nothing |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tier 6 Fresh Start | 2 | 2 or more | 1 | — |
| Tier 5 Rebuild | 2 | 2 or more | 1 | — |
| Tier 4 Standard | 2 | 2 or more | 1 | — |
| Tier 3 Advantage | 3 | 3 or more | 2 | 1 |
| Tier 2 Preferred | 3 | 3 or more | 2 | 1 |
| Tier 1 Select | 3 | 3 or more | 2 | 1 |

Fee-bearing returns are those for insufficient funds, account closed, stop payment or uncollected funds; the rolling 12 months run from records dated later than the same calendar day 12 months before the day the fee is worked out (the last day of that month when that day does not exist) through that day.

**Hypothetical case.** A Tier 2 Preferred contract whose return today is its second fee-bearing return in the window: 2 is one fewer than 3, so 5.00 is added. On a Tier 4 Standard contract the same history reaches the count of 2, so 10.00 is added.
